review_candidates.title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer (Linux Platforms)
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Why we need this role The Senior Infrastructure Engineer is a technical authority responsible for the architecture, detailed design, implementation and lifecycle improvement of Linux-based platforms supporting critical telecommunications network services. Platforms and Services The team designs, deploys, automates and maintains Linux infrastructure supporting: Authoritative, recursive and caching DNS services. Network-Critical Services Design, implement and improve enterprise DNS services, inclu
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: The Senior Engineer will have deep Linux expertise and advanced capability in at least one relevant service domain, such as DNS, routing infrastructure, identity and authentication, or network observability. Security and Compliance Translate security and compliance requirements into platform designs, technical controls and validation criteria. Strong DNS expertise, including design, delegation, resolution, resilience, security, troubleshooting and operational governance. Preferred Qualifications / Education And Experience Degree in Computer Science, Network Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant industry experience.
